purpose: Determine whether the already tested immediate-or-five-session purchase space has enough hindsight terminal-wealth headroom to meet the existing mean-improvement requirement. This is an impossibility screen, not a candidate strategy, predictive validation or integration decision.
priorExposure: All source labels, dates, prices and v4 strategy results have already been examined. Only this descriptive calculation is registered in advance; no unseen holdout or new predictor is claimed.

scope.eligibility: Use exactly the unique monthly dates already included in v4 primaryPredictionDiagnostics. Bind each to maturityQueue by entryDay and to the corresponding primary pairedBaseWindow. Keep all zero-action months. Do not add dates, remove outcomes, change the warmup or expand the calendar/horizon grid.
scope.budget: Each deposit retains USD30%, TQQQ30%, strategic CNY cash40%. Each product may buy at arrival or five common closes later, with the same original common annual terminal, buy/sell fees of 0.001, zero cash interest and no personal taxes. No borrowing, transfers, additional deposits, sales before the terminal or changed asset weights.

definitions.componentLabel: y_j is the frozen annual delayed-minus-immediate terminal wealth divided by the whole deposit, with original weight0.3. Read it from the existing report; do not refit or regenerate model predictions.
definitions.scopeOfBound: These are exact terminal-wealth maxima over the stated binary schedules on each fixed history, assuming future knowledge. They are not bounds for arbitrary waiting dates, changed weights, nonzero cash interest, different fees, taxes or different horizons. Common-action optimum can depend on the annual terminal when component labels have opposite signs. Separate component action signs need future five-session relative prices; their magnitudes still depend on the annual terminal.
definitions.averages: Arithmetic mean across every registered eligible month in each partition, including zeros. Report unconditional median and opportunity-month count for each bound, the mean difference between separate/common bounds, the recorded v4 unconditional mean and mean hindsight gap to v4. Do not average only positive months.
definitions.opportunityCount: Count unique months with the corresponding bound strictly greater than1e-10 percentage points. Two favorable components on one month count once. Also report separate per-component favorable-month counts as diagnostics, never as extra independent observations.
definitions.precision: Use max with mathematical zero and full unrounded values. The1e-10pp tolerance applies only to opportunity counting and the inherited mean gate comparison. Preserve every monthly component label, both bounds, recorded actual delta and bound-minus-actual difference.

necessaryCondition.excluded: If a bound's unconditional mean is below0.5-1e-10pp, no strategy confined to that exact action space and eligible-date scope can meet the original mean economic gate on that partition.
necessaryCondition.notExcluded: Otherwise report only not_excluded_by_wealth_upper_bound. This does not show that information available then could identify opportunities, that a learned signal exists, or that any full validation gate passes.
necessaryCondition.forbidden: Do not apply predictive confirmation, accuracy, action-coverage, bootstrap or joint-risk pass labels to an oracle. Do not change original gates, select a new signal, restore a failed model or create a score. The original goal remains incomplete.

validation: Verify frozen file and statistics fingerprints, exact partition sizes and unique dates.
Match diagnostic labels to the shared queue and selected-leg identity to paired terminal wealth; source v4 status must remain failed and not integration eligible.

For every month, enumerate all four binary component schedules independently and check that the separate bound equals their maximum, the common bound equals max of both-immediate and both-delay, 0<=common<=separate, and recorded v4 wealth is bounded above.

Synthetic cases cover same-sign and opposite-sign labels, negative actual choices, unchanged months, exact-zero and tolerance boundaries; a high hindsight bound must never yield predictive validation.
Check independent aggregate arithmetic, counts, necessary-condition statuses and unchanged source fingerprints after producing the evidence.
stoppingRule: Produce only this fixed diagnostic and its interpretation. Sufficient hindsight opportunity cannot by itself justify another price-only parameter variant or a larger waiting space. A materially new executable signal still requires independent motivation, suitable data and a separately registered validation.
